open_questions: Blue is Color(0.25,0.5,1.0), hue 0.61, set in game/systems.gd SUN_COLORS (data/systems.json may override with sun_color). Owner may want it more cyan or deeper.
handoff: Every open system now has its own sun and orbit rings, at the middle of its planets. System 1 is unchanged (orange, drives key light and flare). System 2's sun is the same grid hue-rotated by the shader (hue_shift uniform) to blue; its orbit rings are tinted 40% toward the sun colour. Only the viewed system's sun and rings show. Frames are cached so a second sun costs no reload. Tests: 498 pass, 0 fail (new _test_system_suns).

details.try: Buy the system 2 permit, open system 2: blue sun at its centre; back to system 1: orange sun.
